rows.label: Concept
rows.text: The **atom** is the smallest reacting particle; the **molecule** the smallest independently existing one; **ions** carry charge; **radicals** act as units (SO₄²⁻) or carry unpaired electrons (Cl·). The **amu** = 1/12 of carbon-12 = 1.66×10⁻²⁷ kg, and **relative atomic mass** compares atoms to that standard. SI's base unit of amount of substance is the **mole** (NEB 2022, 1m).…

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: - 1 amu = 1.66×10⁻²⁷ kg = 1/12 × m(C-12) - n = m/A_r; N = n × 6.022×10²³ - Mean = (x₁+x₂)/2; Δx = (x_max − x_min)/2 - Molecular formula = n × empirical formula

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: **Atom vs molecule:** Fe is an atom (and also its molecule); O₂ is a molecule of two atoms — oxygen's atom is O.  ·  **Empirical = ratio; molecular = reality** — CH₂O is the ratio, C₆H₁₂O₆ the molecule.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: "The empirical formula gives the simplest whole-number ratio of atoms; the molecular formula gives the actual number of atoms in a molecule."

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: ## 1. Topic Introduction — The Vocabulary of Matter Atoms, molecules, ions, radicals, amu, empirical and molecular formula — this topic builds the precise vocabulary every later calculation uses. Master it here and stoichiometry becomes arithmetic; fumble it and every chapter after leaks marks.  ·  ## 2. Fundamental Concepts (NEB 2023, 2022, 2021, 2024) ### 2.1 Atoms, molecules, ions and radicals - **Atom:** the smallest particle of an element that takes part in a chemical reaction (e.g. Fe, He). - **Molecule:** the smallest particle of an element or compound that exists independently (H₂, O₂, CO₂, H₂O). - **Ion:** an atom or group carrying charge — cation (+, e.g. Na⁺) or anion (−, e.g. Cl⁻).…

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: **NEB 2024 (2m): Calculate the number of atoms in 5.6 g of iron (Fe = 56).** — n = 5.6/56 = 0.1 mol; N = 0.1 × 6.022×10²³ = 6.022×10²² atoms.

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: **Significant figures carry through multiplication** — the answer keeps the least precise factor's count.

rows.label: Key points
rows.text: amu = 1.66×10⁻²⁷ kg = 1/12 of C-12. SI base unit of amount = mole. Empirical formula = simplest ratio; molecular = n × empirical.

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: Carbon-12 is the universal mass standard: every relative atomic mass on the periodic table traces to 1/12 of it.
